source: Post-processed from the stored full stress tensor on the Lazzarin-Berto polar grid (the same evaluation that produced igabem_fields.json sed: rc, dA, r0 identical, same point order); unit nominal net stress, thickness mean over z/T 0.125..0.875 of each quantity; void points dropped as there. tr2 = (tr sigma)^2, vm2 = sigma_vM^2; check: (1+nu) s:s - nu tr2 = (2(1+nu)/3) vm2 + ((1-2nu)/3) tr2 = w2E (nu 0.35). W_vol = (1-2nu)/(6E) tr2, W_dev = (1+nu)/(3E) vm2.
